title_zh: 商定暂停加料并询问堆肥箱的堆积问题

scenario.label_zh: 发现堆积后约定向园艺负责人询问
scenario.goal_zh: 描述堆肥表面的积水与纸层，约定拍照请园艺负责人查看再继续加料

context_zh: 合住者检查共享花园的堆肥箱，不提供具体堆肥技术结论。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: There's a worm near the lid, and water has started to accumulate on top.

sentences.speaker: Evie
sentences.text: I can see an accumulation of wet paper too. Did we add all yesterday's packing material?

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Only the plain cardboard. I don't know whether the layers are right.

sentences.speaker: Evie
sentences.text: Neither do I. Let's stop adding anything until Jo has looked at it; she manages the garden.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I'll take a photo of the top and ask her about the water and paper.

sentences.speaker: Evie
sentences.text: Good. I'll leave the new cardboard in the dry box for now.
